# Wedge India

> > Wedge India manufactures and supplies industrial insulation materials, refractory products, prefab construction solutions, and agricultural commodities across India, China, Europe, and global markets.

Wedge India operates as a diversified industrial conglomerate with core divisions in refractory materials, thermal insulation, prefab construction, and agricultural commodities trading. The company specializes in nano-materials insulation systems, high-temperature refractories for steel and cement plants, and energy-efficient modular housing solutions.
